title: Generated decision benchmarks: planted columns, hard negatives, and a sealed partition that holds
request: Decision models need many labelled decisions. Generated tables with planted columns give labels true by construction: thousands per point, across at least a hundred tables, grouped by table, with a sealed partition never used for tuning; every table also with hidden names so a model learns from bands.
spec: Invented tables built from the replicas with planted columns of known kinds; the rules' decisions on them recorded with benchmark labels; per-point sets grouped by table with a sealed partition.
plan: A pure generator in dclab_core: plant, hide names, decide with the data card's rules.
A command that builds every base under many seeds, both variants, through the 19.12 builder.
Commit the manifest only: counts, the rules' score, the sealed fingerprints.

decisions.decision: A table and its hidden-name twin share one group.
decisions.why: They hold the same data: in two splits, the sealed one would be a copy of training.

decisions.decision: Plant negatives with the positives' signatures.
decisions.why: With positives only, one band (a float is a leak) gave every label away.

change: dclab_core/benchgen.py (new; dclab-core 0.18.0), dclab_rnd/decisions_gen.py (new), Makefile (make decisions-gen), .gitignore, the manifest; tests/test_benchgen.py (new); CHANGELOG, CLAUDE.md, the plan, the roadmap.

findings.defect: A table and its hidden-name twin could fall in different splits.
findings.scenario: The same planted data in train and in sealed.
findings.cause: Each variant was its own group.

findings.defect: A hidden name gave the kind away.
findings.scenario: Within a base, f008 was always the identifier.
findings.cause: The columns kept their order when renamed.

findings.defect: A single band gave each label away.
findings.scenario: Every labelled float was a leak: 'float means leak' scored 100%; 95% of sealed states were in training.
findings.cause: Only planted positives and a few negatives, each with its own signature.
findings.fix: Nine negatives with the positives' signatures; no field alone reaches 97% on any point.

findings.defect: column.category_code had too few decisions, and the test could not see it.
findings.scenario: 1,440 decisions; the test checked three points.
findings.fix: More kinds settle it (4,800); the test checks all six points.

findings.defect: The 'sum' was not a sum identity.
findings.scenario: A noisy copy whose other part was never planted.
findings.cause: The noise column was not added.
findings.fix: Both parts planted: they add up to the outcome exactly; the part alone is a negative.

findings.cause: Labels were compared with the table they came from.
findings.fix: Each kind checked from its values.

findings.defect: The sealed fingerprint hashed only record ids.
findings.scenario: A change to the generator changed sealed labels without changing the fingerprint.
findings.cause: Ids do not depend on values.
findings.fix: Hash the records, states and labels together.

measurements.name: decisions per point
measurements.gate: a few thousand labelled decisions per point across at least a hundred tables
measurements.result: 4,800 to 8,160 per point across 240 table groups (480 tables)
measurements.against_gate: 4,800 and more against a few thousand
limits: Ten bases: the sealed partition holds new seeds of known bases.

measurements.name: sealed lookup shortcut
measurements.gate: no single band gives a label away (below 97%)
measurements.result: below 97% for every field and point; a lookup of a whole sealed state in training is right 84-99% of the time
limits: Bands together still carry much of each label.

outcome: 44,640 labelled decisions on 480 invented tables, one set per decision point with a sealed partition by table group. No single band gives a label away, and the hidden names say nothing.
lessons: A planted benchmark with positives only teaches the planting, not the decision: plant negatives that look the same.
Twins of one table belong in one split.
Fingerprint what a sealed set holds, not only its ids.
risks: The bases are ten replicas; the public tables have no declared outcome yet.
